purpose: Turn the JANUS/TRUMP mirror-plus-reverse idea into a falsifiable, non-operational computational audit for viral assembly/disassembly pathway representations. The method asks what information is missing when a forward pathway is compared with an independently observed reverse pathway.

epistemic_boundary.working_statement: Elapsed time is treated as an index of state transitions, not as a causal antiviral operator.
not_claimed: time does not exist as an established physical fact
viral processes are literally reversible in vivo
the mirror-reverse framework is a treatment
the framework discovers new antiviral interventions by itself
retrospective agreement is equivalent to prospective blind prediction

core_objects.mirror_operator: M maps reverse direction into the forward comparison orientation without assuming equal states, rates, barriers or contexts.
core_objects.interpretation: A non-empty mirror difference is a witness that the current forward representation does not fully encode the observed reverse dynamics at the selected resolution.

components.D_state: reverse-observed state or morphology classes that cannot be represented by the forward state vocabulary
components.D_edge: reverse-observed transition classes, ordering, rates, barriers or branching that are absent from the forward transition contract
components.D_context: direction-dependent environmental, maturation or host-context variables required to make the two trajectories mutually intelligible
components.D_observation: uncertainty created by finite temporal/spatial resolution or bulk averaging that prevents a justified symmetry/asymmetry verdict

mirror_debt.law: NO_FREE_MIRROR_COMPRESSION: failure to observe a reverse-specific state is not permission to set its debt to zero.

audit_algorithm: freeze the forward state vocabulary and transition contract
independently encode the reverse observations without forcing them into the forward vocabulary
mirror only the direction of comparison, not the identities or costs of states and edges
compute reported state-class and transition-class mismatches
classify each mismatch as state, edge, context or observation debt
run negative controls where the literature explicitly reports reversible/shared pathways
block novelty or predictive claims unless a withheld or prospective validation survives

external_benchmark.system: cowpea chlorotic mottle virus empty capsid / capsid protein

forward_evidence.reported_path: free dimers -> major intermediate resembling a half-capsid -> capsid

reverse_evidence.reported_path_summary: swelling is followed by disassembly through two successive large/smaller intermediate classes before dimers; the two intermediates were reported as unexpected and not identified in prior self-assembly experiments

external_benchmark.reason: The reverse pathway contains experimentally inferred intermediate structure classes not accounted for by the then-available assembly representation. Exact node-to-node identity with later assembly intermediates is not asserted.

external_benchmark.system: hepatitis B virus Cp149 empty capsid

evidence.assembly_summary: nucleation-growth followed by slow relaxation of capsid-like transient species
evidence.disassembly_summary: unexpected fractal-branched clusters that disappear on a much longer trajectory

external_benchmark.system: hepatitis B virus capsid assembly/disassembly energetics

evidence.reported_result: assembly and disassembly show hysteresis including differences in inferred association free energy, energy barriers and critical nucleus size

external_benchmark.reason: Mirror asymmetry can reside in transition metadata even when state labels alone are insufficient to expose it.

external_benchmark.system: minute virus of mice T=1 capsid

evidence.reported_result: mechanically induced disassembly intermediates corresponded to intermediates predicted by reversible assembly/disassembly models
assembly and disassembly observations supported an experiment-based reversible self-assembly pathway

external_benchmark.reason: This is a negative control against a method that would label every virus capsid pathway as reverse-specific.

external_benchmark.system: HIV-1 capsid protein two-dimensional lattice observed by high-speed AFM

evidence.reported_result: multiple stochastic association and dissociation trajectories were directly observed; the authors explicitly describe the local process as fully reversible with the same alternative pathways available in reverse

external_benchmark.reason: Strong negative control: Mirror-JANUS must not manufacture state debt where direct imaging supports local reversibility.

benchmark_summary.result: The audit is nontrivial at the literature-description level: it separates reverse-specific state debt, kinetic/edge debt, and mirror-compatible controls instead of returning asymmetry for every system.
benchmark_summary.limitation: This R1 is retrospective and literature-grounded. It is not a prospective blind prediction benchmark and does not yet establish information gain beyond expert interpretation.

candidate_contribution.name: JANUS Mirror-Debt Audit
candidate_contribution.distinctive_step: Treat forward/reverse mismatch as typed representation debt: missing state vocabulary, missing edge/kinetic metadata, missing context variables, or insufficient observability. A reverse-specific observation becomes a witness against the sufficiency of the forward representation rather than merely a qualitative statement that the pathways differ.
candidate_contribution.not_yet_demonstrated: prospective or withheld-data predictive information gain

required_pass: freeze a forward graph from data that excludes a withheld reverse segment or state class
generate a ranked representation-debt hypothesis without access to the withheld labels
unblind and score whether the withheld reverse data confirms the predicted missing state/edge class
include at least one reversible negative control
report failures and UNKNOWN results without reinterpretation
next_gate.outreach_rule: Do not tell researchers that the method is useful to them as a fact until R2 demonstrates external information gain. R1 may be shared transparently as an open method proposal and retrospective benchmark if clearly labeled.

verdict.shareable_as: open computational method proposal plus clearly labeled retrospective cross-system sanity benchmark
verdict.not_shareable_as: validated antiviral discovery method or proven new virology theorem
